messages:
maria (PM): FYI customer Atlas wants predictable short bursts on their Dedicated pool during onboarding — target: 5m bursts up to ~10k tokens/s above a 2k baseline. cc @sophia
aj (eng): Do they need hard guarantees or would a credits/soft-burst suffice? Pricing changes a lot either way.
leo (eng-runtime): We can implement soft-reserve with credits + preemption fallback. Hard-reserve implies committing GPUs and longer procurement.
sophia (sales): Contract language requested 'guaranteed burst' but they said they'd consider tiers. I'll push for Silver (credits) first unless Gold (hard) is required.
nate (sre): Must have observability & guardrails before we promise anything: per-tenant p95/p99, eviction churn metrics, and alerts for p99 >500ms. Also need a rollback runbook.
maria (PM): Proposed MVP launch criteria:
- Pilot with 3 customers for 2 weeks
- Billing export for burst usage + reconciliation
- Canary runbook and automated rollback path
- Automated stress test: 2x burst for 10m without >1% error
aj (eng): Implementation outline:
- API to create burst profile and credits ledger
- Autoscale gating so short bursts don't trigger long-term scale-up
- Preemption policy + tenant priority metadata
- Billing hook for burst metering
- Canary orchestration endpoint
leo (eng-runtime): Runtime details: continuous-batching warms up slowly; to hit 10k tokens/s for 5m we need a burst-warmup path or maintain a small hot slab. Recommend small warm pool + kernel priming during canary.
aj (eng): Draft API example:
```json
POST /v1/dedicated/pools/{pool_id}/burst
{
  "mode": "soft",
  "credits": 5000,
  "window_seconds": 300,
  "preempt_priority": 20
}
```
sophia (sales): For contracts I'll propose three tiers: Bronze=best-effort, Silver=soft-reserve credits (pilot), Gold=hard-reserve SLA. Legal review needed for "guarantee" wording; propose remedies limited to credits/refund.
nate (sre): Suggested SLOs for Silver pilot: baseline p95 <200ms, p99 <500ms during burst, error rate <0.5%. We'll add eviction stress tests and alert thresholds.
leo (eng-runtime): Risk note: simultaneous bursts across many tenants can exhaust headroom quickly -> need fair-share plus sticky routing to reduce oscillation. Also pre-warm hints from API helps.
maria (PM): Timeline: kickoff tomorrow, MVP (soft-reserve + credits + canary) in ~6 sprints if scope accepted. Hard-reserve SLA as separate epic. Owners?
sophia (sales): I'll own customer comms and contract draft.
leo (eng-runtime): I'll own runtime and canary orchestration.
aj (eng): I'll own API + billing hooks.
nate (sre): I'll own alerts, runbook, and acceptance tests.
maria (PM): Action items: create JIRA epics, schedule 30m kickoff, draft acceptance test matrix, add to roadmap slide. :white_check_mark:
canary-bot: Canary scheduled for pool:atlas-canary at 1749157400. Results will post to #product-canaries.
sophia (sales): Looping in legal tomorrow.
maria (PM): Captured here for commitments and next steps.
